admission.justification: Keeping all alternate paths in shared history would retain variable path data even though the history only needs an equality witness.

applicability: The shared Git object generation history's entries keyed by repository and addition policy.
conditions: A SHA-256 fingerprint of sorted length-framed alternate path bytes supplies equality.
A revision transition uses the complete incoming census and the existing addition policy.
exclusions: The request may still need current alternate paths to discover and measure the full object store.

evidence: bug-r18-W2-expanded-evidence.md, L18-F04, exact revision-transition and retained graph checks.
handoff.path: BUG-L18 W2 affected knowledge and initial history

statement: The shared Git generation history retains a fixed-size digest of the sorted alternate paths and continues to derive each new revision from the full incoming census.
